newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Death toll rises to 29 in Indonesian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises to 29 in Indonesian plane crash.

text.p: The death toll in Thursday's plane crash near the Indonesian city of Bandung has risen to 29 after another injured passenger died in hospital, an airline official said.
An official at Sempati Air's emergency centre, Taufik, told Reuters on Saturday that an Indonesian passenger named Yeshi Nasilma had died in hospital in Bandung on Friday afternoon.
"Yeshi died yesterday afternoon at about 4 p.m.. The body has already been flown to her home town Padang in West Sumatra," Taufik said.
Earlier reports had put the death toll at 28 of the 50 people aboard the plane.

Three residents of a housing estate were injured when the plane clipped the roof of their house moments before crashing into a field while attempting an emergency landing at a military air base at about midday on Thursday.
The cause of the accident is still under investigation and rescue workers recovered the flight recorders from the Dutch-built Fokker F-27 twin engined turbo prop on Friday.
Officials have said the pilot had radioed to Bandung's main airport shortly after take-off that one engine had stopped and he had requested permission to land again.
